project_summary: Write and finish a first draft of an 80,000-word literary novel in 6 months while working full-time. No outline, no genre.

failure_risk.risk: Drafting 80,000 words in 26 weeks at 440 words/day, alongside a full-time job and with no outline, will almost certainly stall in the middle of the book.
failure_risk.minimum_test: Run a 4-week pilot at 440 words/day from a 1-page outline. Pass = ≥80% of days on target and ≥10,000 words total.
